card.name: Last word before OF/AND in capitals
card.fires_on: The last piece of a noun in ALL-CAPS label text, just before the next word OF or AND. Seen in phrases like NEEDS AND RESPONSE, INCIDENCE OF, REACH OF CHILDREN, and YEARS OF AGE.

modes.label: Dosage individualized sentence
modes.description: The S ending NEEDS in the stock capitalized dosage line, where AND comes next.
modes.example: DOSAGE SHOULD BE INDIVIDUALIZED ACCORDING TO THE NEED<<S>> AND THE RESPONSE OF THE PATIENT.

modes.label: Noun before OF
modes.description: The end of a capitalized noun that is followed by OF, such as INCIDENCE, REACH or YEARS.
modes.example: KEEP THIS AND ALL MEDICATIONS OUT OF THE RE<<ACH>> OF CHILDREN.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write Of or And next, including the capitalized forms.
card.plain: It fires on the last word piece in capitalized label text when the next word is likely OF or AND.
